disable.docs: This action deactivates a `key_collector`. It will stop accepting keys and will clear any already collected ones. If there is more than one key collector, you will need to provide the `id` of the one to disable.

enable.docs: This action activates a `key_collector`. It will start accepting keys. If there is more than one key collector, you will need to provide the `id` of the one to enable.

allowed_keys.docs:
**string**: Keys allowed to be used. If not specified, then any otherwise unused keys will be allowed.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

back_keys.docs:
**string**: Keys used to delete the last pressed key. Like *Backspace* on a keyboard.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

clear_keys.docs:
**string**: Keys used to cancel building the key sequence.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

enable_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: If enabled, this key collector will be enabled on boot. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

end_key_required.docs:
**boolean**: Only trigger `on_result` automation when one of the `end_keys` was pressed, and not when `max_length` characters have been entered. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

end_keys.docs:
**string**: Keys used to *finish* the key sequence and trigger the `on_result` automation.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this entry for use in lambdas.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

max_length.docs:
**integer**: The maximum length of the desired key sequence. After this limit is reached, the collector will either ignore additional keys or trigger the `on_result` automation, depending on `end_key_required`.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

min_length.docs:
**integer**: The minimum length of the desired key sequence. Below this limit, `on_result` automation will not trigger even if any of the `end_keys` was pressed.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

on_progress.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when keys are pressed. The current key sequence is placed in a `vector<uint8_t>` variable `x` and `start` holds the start key that activated this key sequence or else `0`. Useful if you want to have a display showing the current value or number of key presses, or a speaker beeping when keys are being pressed.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

on_result.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the key sequence has been finished (eg. `max_length` has been reached or one of the `end_keys` was pressed). The finalized key sequence is placed in a `vector<uint8_t>` variable `x`, `start` holds the start key that activated this key sequence or else `0`, and `end` holds the end key that terminated this key sequence or else `0`.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

on_timeout.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform if the timeout happens. The current key sequence is placed in a `vector<uint8_t>` variable `x` and `start` holds the start key that activated this key sequence or else `0`.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

source_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the key collector component to monitor.

*See also: [Key Collector Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

start_keys.docs:
**string**: Keys used to *start* the key sequence; when set, no keys will be accepted until one of the start keys is pressed.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*

timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Timeout after which to cancel building the key sequence.

*See also: [Key collector component](https://esphome.io/components/key_collector#configuration-variables)*
